levels.surface: أبي محمد الحسن بن عيسى العلوي

notes: «أبي عيسى بن محمد» and «أبيه» + name are one link each, named alone (rule 7)
The Imam Musa inside the chain after «عن أخيه» is a narrator; his saying «قال لي: يا بني» is the saying
«قال أبو الحسن: فقلت له» is a further exchange in which Abu al-Hasan speaks inside the story; not added, since whether he is the last link is a rule 6 doubt
